scanNote:
WORKBOOK 36-BET. Unit 9 'Times Change...' — Greenhill shahar xaritasi.

1a-mashqda 10 ta raqamlangan bino bor, har biri RASM (belgi) bilan ko'rsatilgan. Skaner bilan tekshirildi, HAMMASI TO'G'RI:
  1 restaurant (likopchada pichoq-vilka-qoshiq), 2 newsagent's (gazeta), 3 greengrocer's (olma va banan), 4 butcher's (go'sht bo'lagi), 5 chemist's (dori shishasi va tabletkalar), 6 cinema (kinoapparat), 7 baker's (non), 8 supermarket (xarid aravachasi), 9 library (kitoblar), 10 post office (xatlar).

1b va 1c mashqlari ham to'liq to'g'ri (10 tadan).

2-MAShQ — XARITADAN O'QILADI, tekshirildi:
  1 opposite — newsagent's (2) va greengrocer's (3) High Street'ning ikki tomonida
  2 next to — chemist's (5) va supermarket (8) yonma-yon
  3 between — butcher's (4) restaurant (1) bilan baker's (7) orasida
  4 in front of — avtobus bekati pochta oldida
  5 on — 'ON the corner of' o'zgarmas ibora

⚠ Ro'yxatda ANIQ 5 ta predlog va 5 ta bo'shliq bor — har biri bir martadan ishlatiladi. Bu javoblarni tekshirishning oson yo'li.

⚠ Xaritada 2-band biroz erkin: chemist's supermarketning USTIDA joylashgan (yonida emas), lekin kitob 'next to' deb hisoblaydi.

sections.title: Vocabulary — the town map of Greenhill

exercises.instructionEn: This is the town map of Greenhill. Use the words from the list below and label the places.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu — Greenhill shahar xaritasi. Quyidagi ro'yxatdagi so'zlardan foydalanib joylarni nomlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (10 ta):
  newsagent's, butcher's, library, baker's, greengrocer's,
  chemist's, post office, restaurant, supermarket, cinema

Har bir binoda RASM bor — shu rasmga qarab nomni topasiz.

DIQQAT — DO'KON NOMLARIDAGI APOSTROF ('s):
  baker      = nonvoy (ODAM)
  baker'S    = nonvoyxona (JOY)
  butcher    = qassob (ODAM)
  butcher'S  = qassobxona (JOY)

Sababi: to'liq shakli "the baker'S SHOP" edi —
'shop' so'zi tushib qolgan, apostrof qolgan.
Shuning uchun bu do'konlar DOIM 's bilan yoziladi.

APOSTROFSIZ JOYLAR:
  library, post office, restaurant, supermarket, cinema
  (bular biror kasb egasining nomi bilan atalmagan)

XARITA TUZILISHI:

     │Oak                      │High
     │Street                   │Street
  ───┼─────────────┬───────────┼──────────────
     │ 1 RESTAURANT│ 2 NEWS-   │ 3 GREENGROCER'S
     │             │   AGENT'S │
     ├─────────────┼───────────┼──────────────
     │ 4 BUTCHER'S │ 5 CHEMIST'S│ 6 CINEMA
     ├─────────────┼───────────┼──────────────
     │ 7 BAKER'S   │ 8 SUPER-  │ 9 LIBRARY
     │             │   MARKET  │
  ═══╪═════ PARK STREET ═══════╪══════════════
     │ 10 POST OFFICE (+ BUS STOP oldida)

⚠ NEGA DO'KON NOMLARIDA APOSTROF BOR?

  butcher'S, baker'S, greengrocer'S,
  chemist'S, newsagent'S

  ⚠ Bu — BRITANIYA an'anasi. To'liq shakli:
     'the butcher's SHOP' = qassobning
     do'koni.
  Keyinchalik 'shop' so'zi tushib qolgan,
  apostrof esa qolgan.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 'at the butcher's' deyiladi
  — 'at the butcher shop' EMAS.

  ⚠ Xuddi shu qoida: 'at the doctor's'
  (shifokorda), 'at my aunt's' (xolamnikida).


⚠ BRITANChA / AMERIKAChA:

  chemist's (BrE)  = drugstore / pharmacy (AmE)
  greengrocer's (BrE) — Amerikada bunday
     alohida do'kon deyarli yo'q, hammasi
     supermarketda sotiladi
  cinema (BrE)     = movie theater (AmE)

items.whyUz:
Pichoq-vilka rasmi → RESTAURANT (restoran).
Apostrof YO'Q.

Gazeta rasmi → NEWSAGENT'S (gazeta do'koni).
'news' + 'agent' + 's.
Gazeta, jurnal, sigaret, konfet sotiladi.

Meva rasmi → GREENGROCER'S (meva-sabzavot do'koni).
'green' (yashil) + 'grocer' (oziq-ovqat sotuvchisi).

Go'sht rasmi → BUTCHER'S (qassobxona).
'a butcher' = qassob (odam).

Dori rasmi → CHEMIST'S (dorixona).
'a chemist' = dorixonachi.
Amerikacha: drugstore / pharmacy.

Kinoapparat rasmi → CINEMA (kinoteatr).
Apostrof YO'Q.
Amerikacha: movie theater.

Non rasmi → BAKER'S (nonvoyxona).
'a baker' = nonvoy; 'to bake' = pishirmoq.

Aravacha rasmi → SUPERMARKET.
Apostrof YO'Q.
Hamma narsa bir joyda sotiladi.

Kitoblar rasmi → LIBRARY (kutubxona).
DIQQAT: 'library' = kutubxona (kitob QARZGA olinadi),
'a bookshop' = kitob do'koni (kitob SOTIB olinadi).
Bu — juda ko'p adashtiriladigan so'z.

Xat rasmi → POST OFFICE (pochta bo'limi).
Apostrof YO'Q.
Yonida BUS STOP (avtobus bekati) bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the phrases in column A to the places in column B.
exercises.instructionUz: A ustunidagi iboralarni B ustunidagi joylarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
A ustunida — NIMA QILISH mumkinligi,
B ustunida — QAYSI JOYDA.

Kitobda IKKI juftlik allaqachon chizilgan:
  1 buy food        → g supermarket
  7 buy some aspirin → d chemist's

B USTUNIDAGI JOYLAR:
  a post office     f library
  b baker's         g supermarket
  c restaurant      h greengrocer's
  d chemist's       i newsagent's
  e butcher's       j cinema

USUL: har bir harakat uchun 'bu narsa qayerda sotiladi
yoki qilinadi?' deb so'rang.

pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDA CHIZILGAN.
Supermarketda hamma turdagi oziq-ovqat bor.

'watch a film' = film ko'rmoq → CINEMA.
Amerikacha: 'watch a movie'.

Go'sht faqat qassobxonada (yoki supermarketda) sotiladi.
'meat' = go'sht.
'to send a letter' = xat jo'natmoq → POST OFFICE.

'to BORROW' = qarzga OLMOQ (qaytarib berish sharti bilan) →
LIBRARY.
DIQQAT: kutubxonada kitob SOTIB OLINMAYDI, qarzga olinadi.
'to lend' = qarzga BERMOQ (teskarisi).

Non nonvoyxonada pishiriladi va sotiladi.
'bread' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot ('a bread' XATO).

KITOBDA CHIZILGAN.
Aspirin — dori → CHEMIST'S.
'some' — sanalmaydigan ot bilan.

'to HAVE dinner' = kechki ovqat yemoq ('eat' emas, HAVE).
Shunga o'xshash: have breakfast, have lunch.

'fruit and vegetables' → GREENGROCER'S.
'fruit' odatda sanalmaydigan; 'vegetables' — ko'plik.

exercises.instructionEn: Now use the prompts from b) to make sentences about what you can do in each place.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi b) dagi iboralardan foydalanib har bir joyda nima qilish mumkinligi haqida gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  You can buy food at the supermarket.

QOLIP:
  You CAN [harakat] AT THE [joy].

UCH DIQQAT:

  1) 'can' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda, 'to' siz:
        You can BUY.     ✓
        You can TO buy.  ✗

  2) Joy oldidan AT THE:
        at the supermarket, at the baker's,
        at the post office
     Apostrofli do'konlarda ham 'the' qoladi:
        at THE baker'S   ✓

  3) 'You' bu yerda ANIQ ODAM emas —
     'odamlar umuman' ma'nosida ishlatiladi.

items.answer: You can buy food at the supermarket.
items.whyUz: Qolip: You can + fe'l + at the + joy.

items.answer: You can watch a film at the cinema.
items.whyUz: 'at the cinema' — kinoteatrda.

items.answer: You can buy meat at the butcher's.
items.whyUz: 'at THE butcher'S' — 'the' ham, apostrof ham qoladi.

items.answer: You can send a letter at the post office.
items.whyUz: 'send a letter' = xat jo'natmoq.

items.answer: You can borrow books at the library.
items.whyUz:
'borrow' = qarzga olmoq.
'books' ko'plikda — artikl kerak emas.

items.answer: You can buy bread at the baker's.
items.whyUz: 'bread' sanalmaydigan → artiklsiz.

items.answer: You can buy some aspirin at the chemist's.
items.whyUz: 'some aspirin' — sanalmaydigan ot bilan 'some'.

items.answer: You can have dinner at the restaurant.
items.whyUz: 'have dinner' — 'dinner' oldidan artikl YO'Q.

items.answer: You can buy fruit and vegetables at the greengrocer's.
items.whyUz: Ikkala ot ham artiklsiz.

items.answer: You can buy newspapers and magazines at the newsagent's.
items.whyUz: Ikkalasi ham ko'plikda — artikl kerak emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the map of Greenhill again. Use in front of, between, opposite, next to, or on to fill in the blanks in the sentences below.
exercises.instructionUz: Greenhill xaritasiga yana qarang. Quyidagi gaplardagi bo'shliqlarni in front of, between, opposite, next to yoki on bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: in front of, between, opposite, next to, on

Besh predlog, besh gap — HAR BIRI AYNAN BIR MARTA.
Bu tekshirish uchun yaxshi belgi: agar bittasi
ikki marta chiqsa, xato qilgansiz.

XARITANI ESLANG:

     │Oak                      │High
     │Street                   │Street
  ───┼─────────────┬───────────┼──────────────
     │ 1 RESTAURANT│ 2 NEWS-   │ 3 GREENGROCER'S
     │             │   AGENT'S │
     ├─────────────┼───────────┼──────────────
     │ 4 BUTCHER'S │ 5 CHEMIST'S│ 6 CINEMA
     ├─────────────┼───────────┼──────────────
     │ 7 BAKER'S   │ 8 SUPER-  │ 9 LIBRARY
     │             │   MARKET  │
  ═══╪═════ PARK STREET ═══════╪══════════════
     │ 10 POST OFFICE (+ BUS STOP oldida)

QOIDA:
  ko'cha AJRATADI       → opposite
  ko'cha AJRATMAYDI     → next to
  ikkitasining o'rtasida → between
  binoning old tomonida  → in front of
  ikki ko'cha kesishmasi → on the corner of

items.whyUz:
Gazeta do'koni High Street ning G'ARBIDA,
meva do'koni SHARQIDA → ko'cha ajratadi → OPPOSITE.
Ikkalasi ham yuqori qatorda.

Dorixona (5) va supermarket (8) BIR ustunda,
yonma-yon — ko'cha ajratmaydi → NEXT TO.

items.textEn: 3  The butcher's is ............ the restaurant and the baker's.
items.whyUz:
Chap ustun: RESTAURANT (1) → BUTCHER'S (4) → BAKER'S (7).
Qassobxona ikkisining O'RTASIDA → BETWEEN.
'between A AND B' — 'and' shart.

items.textEn: 4  The bus stop is ............ the post office.
items.whyUz:
Xaritada avtobus bekati pochta binosining OLDIDA turibdi →
IN FRONT OF.
Aksi: behind.

items.textEn: 5  The supermarket is ............ the corner of High Street and Park Street.
items.whyUz:
'ON the corner of X and Y' — o'zgarmas ibora.
Supermarket High Street va Park Street kesishgan joyda.

wordFormation.introUz: 36-bet — do'kon nomlari va ulardagi apostrof qoidasi.

groups.explanationUz:
To'liq shakli "the baker'S SHOP" edi — 'shop' tushib qolgan,
apostrof qolgan. Shuning uchun bu do'konlar DOIM 's bilan.
Kasb egasining nomi bilan atalmagan joylar.
Ikkalasi ham 'qarz' haqida, lekin yo'nalishi teskari.

items.derived: I borrow a book FROM the library.
The library lends books TO me.

groups.explanationUz: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlarga e'tibor bering.

patterns.formula: You CAN + fe'l + AT THE + joy.
patterns.exampleEn: You can buy food at the supermarket. You can borrow books at the library.
patterns.exampleUz: Supermarketda oziq-ovqat sotib olsa bo'ladi. Kutubxonada kitob qarzga olsa bo'ladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'can' dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda.
Joy oldidan 'at the' — apostrofli do'konlarda ham.

patterns.formula: The X is OPPOSITE / NEXT TO the Y.
patterns.exampleEn: The newsagent's is opposite the greengrocer's. The chemist's is next to the supermarket.
patterns.exampleUz: Gazeta do'koni meva do'koni ro'parasida. Dorixona supermarket yonida.
patterns.explanationUz: Ko'cha ajratsa — opposite;  ajratmasa — next to.

patterns.formula: The X is BETWEEN the Y AND the Z.
patterns.exampleEn: The butcher's is between the restaurant and the baker's.

patterns.formula: The X is IN FRONT OF the Y.
patterns.exampleEn: The bus stop is in front of the post office.
patterns.explanationUz: Uch so'z — hammasi kerak.  Aksi: behind.

patterns.formula: The X is ON THE CORNER OF ... Street AND ... Street.
patterns.exampleEn: The supermarket is on the corner of High Street and Park Street.
patterns.exampleUz: Supermarket High Street va Park Street burchagida.
